product.name: Commercial Lending
product.description: Provides various loan products including term loans, construction loans, SBA loans, lines of credit, letters of credit, and commercial mortgages to support business growth.

product.name: Business Banking Accounts
product.description: Offers business checking and savings accounts to manage daily financial transactions and grow business funds.

product.name: Merchant Services
product.description: Enables businesses to accept point-of-sale payments through various payment processing solutions.

product.name: Treasury Management Services
product.description: Provides cash management tools such as ACH origination, positive pay, wire transfers, lockbox services, and zero balance accounts to optimize business cash flow and security.

product.name: Online and Mobile Banking
product.description: Digital platforms that provide 24/7 access to account management, bill pay, transfers, and other banking services for personal and business customers.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Includes personal checking, savings, CDs, money market accounts, and retirement accounts for individual financial management.
